evidence.claim: Provided external context states APT is the universal intermediate stage through which tungsten ore is converted into metal powder, WF6, or cemented carbide tooling, and states Chinese APT exports were zero in January and February 2026.

Kennametal says it manufactures tungsten carbide powders by carburizing tungsten powders produced in its tungsten oxide reduction process, serving markets including aerospace, oil and gas, energy, earthworks, construction, metal cutting and process industries.
Kennametal completed its acquisition of ATI's Tungsten Materials business in 2013, and the release said the business combination included tungsten production and recycling capabilities.
evidence.source_title: Kennametal Completes Acquisition of Tungsten Materials Business from ATI

evidence.claim: Almonty announced a Nasdaq listing under ALM and a US$90 million offering, stating the capital would fund development of its Sangdong tungsten oxide facility and that it was mining, processing and shipping tungsten concentrate from Panasqueira in Portugal.
evidence.source_title: Almonty Announces Nasdaq Listing Concurrent with Pricing of US$90 Million Upsized, Oversubscribed Public Offering

evidence.claim: Air Products disclosed construction of a second tungsten hexafluoride production plant at its Hometown, Pennsylvania facility to meet contracted electronics customer needs.
evidence.source_title: Air Products Investing in Second WF6 Plant to Meet Production Needs of Contracted Electronics Customers

A trade profile says Global Tungsten & Powders sources tungsten concentrate from the US Defense Logistics Agency stockpile, reinforcing the coverage gap that important non-China tungsten processing assets may be private.

memory_update.text: KMT is the best US-listed underfollowed downstream tungsten intermediate candidate found in this pass: explicit tungsten carbide powders, tungsten oxide reduction process, and recycling/production history.

ALM is a US-listed non-China upstream/oxide candidate, but current evidence supports concentrate and planned tungsten oxide rather than confirmed APT processing; treat as adjacent, not pure node exposure.
APD is a large-cap reference anchor for WF6 semiconductor demand pull, not an underfollowed APT processor.

The most direct non-China APT/recycling processor found, Global Tungsten & Powders, appears private within Plansee/Ceratizit; public-market exposure may be indirect through tooling, specialty gases, miners, or weak materials hypotheses.

Need a later evidence pass focused on actual APT capability, ore/feedstock source, customer qualification, and revenue materiality; many public candidates are downstream users or converters rather than APT processors.

node: Tungsten APT processing and downstream tungsten intermediates
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the tungsten APT/intermediate chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. The strongest direct underfollowed candidates are Kennametal, via tungsten carbide powders/recycling/downstream tooling, and Almonty, via non-China tungsten concentrate and planned tungsten oxide capacity rather than current APT. Air Products is a reference downstream semiconductor-gas name because it has disclosed WF6 capacity, but it is too large and diversified for the underfollowed lane. Materion is included only as a weak hypothesis because public evidence supports specialty powders and tungsten carbide materials, but not material APT or tungsten conversion exposure.
